paired_measurement.contention: a 256 MiB dd write loop to the external HDD
paired_measurement.design: ALTERNATING paired reps: quiet, noisy, quiet, noisy ... so both arms sit at the same thermal and page-cache state
paired_measurement.why_alternating: sequential blocks measured warm-up rather than contention and reported the contended runs 6.72% FASTER

guard.reason_example: CPU_READY declined: a protected window is open (QWEN_PERFORMANCE_QUALIFICATION (G005)). CPU_READY moves bytes through the same fabric the measurement is reading, so filling this slot would forge the number.

no_forged_speedups: the uncontended figures in QWEN_PERFORMANCE_QUALIFICATION.json were taken inside the protected window, with the contaminating queues declined; the contended figures here were taken deliberately outside it to size the effect.
